## 🎉 Course complete!

You've completed this proof-of-concept course covering:

1. Installing the SDK and creating an `Anthropic` client.
2. Making your first `messages.create()` call.
3. Inspecting the full response object (`id`, `model`, `stop_reason`,
   `usage`).

This is the same three required parameters, response shape, and client
setup you'll use for every other feature of the SDK — streaming, tool use,
vision, prompt caching, batches, async clients, and more.

### What's next?

This repo currently wires up 3 of the 21 sections in the full Anthropic
Python SDK reference material. See `COURSE-ARCHITECTURE.md` for how the
remaining sections follow the exact same pattern (a `.github/steps/*.md`
file + a `.github/workflows/*.yml` file + a small Python checker) — feel
free to keep extending this repo yourself, or ask whoever set this course up
to add more steps.

Thanks for learning with us! ⭐ Star the template repo if you found this
useful.
